questions.question: What is the purpose of the Delta Lake transaction log (_delta_log)?
options: Records every change to the table for ACID guarantees and versioning
questions.correctAnswer: Records every change to the table for ACID guarantees and versioning
questions.explanation: The transaction log is a series of JSON files that record every commit (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE). It enables ACID transactions, time travel, and concurrent read/write access.

questions.question: What does OPTIMIZE do to a Delta table?
options: Compacts many small files into fewer, larger files for better performance
Compresses data with a new codec
questions.correctAnswer: Compacts many small files into fewer, larger files for better performance
questions.explanation: OPTIMIZE merges small Parquet files into larger ones (target ~1GB). This improves read performance by reducing file overhead and enables better data skipping.

questions.question: What does Liquid Clustering (CLUSTER BY) do?
options: Automatically organizes data using space-filling curves, adapting as data and query patterns change — without full table rewrites
Sorts data alphabetically by clustering columns
Creates a secondary index on clustering columns
questions.correctAnswer: Automatically organizes data using space-filling curves, adapting as data and query patterns change — without full table rewrites
questions.explanation: Liquid Clustering replaces legacy Z-ORDER and partitioning. It uses space-filling curves to co-locate related data, adapts incrementally as data and query patterns change, and supports altering clustering columns without rewriting the entire table.

questions.question: Why should VACUUM retention be set to at least 7 days?
options: To avoid deleting files needed by running queries or streaming checkpoints
To match the log retention period
questions.correctAnswer: To avoid deleting files needed by running queries or streaming checkpoints
questions.explanation: Long-running queries and streaming jobs may reference older file versions. Vacuuming with too short a retention could remove files still being read, causing query failures.

questions.question: How do you query a Delta table as it existed at version 42?
options: SELECT * FROM table VERSION AS OF 42
questions.correctAnswer: SELECT * FROM table VERSION AS OF 42
questions.explanation: Time travel syntax uses VERSION AS OF or TIMESTAMP AS OF to query historical snapshots. Each commit creates a new version, allowing you to view the table's state at any point.

questions.question: [Recall: Lakehouse] What file format does Delta Lake store data in?
questions.explanation: Recall from Lakehouse Fundamentals: Delta Lake stores data in Parquet format (columnar, compressed), with a JSON transaction log on top for ACID guarantees.

questions.question: [Recall: Ingestion] What is Auto Loader's advantage over COPY INTO?
options: Incremental streaming — processes only new files automatically
questions.correctAnswer: Incremental streaming — processes only new files automatically
questions.explanation: Recall from Data Ingestion: Auto Loader tracks processed files and streams only new ones. COPY INTO requires manual re-execution for new files.

learnings: Transaction log provides atomicity and versioning
Time travel enables querying historical versions
OPTIMIZE compacts small files for better performance
Liquid Clustering (CLUSTER BY) is the modern layout strategy
VACUUM removes old files respecting retention
